progressDetails:
1. At the end of each turn, you will gain 3 <color=#FF423F>Deployment Points</color>.
2. Upon reaching 20 <color=#FF423F>Deployment Points</color>, automatically spend 20 Deployment Points and receive 1 <color=#FF423F>Self-Destruct Bot</color> and 1 <color=#FF423F>Combat Drone</color> (the number can increase based on how many points you have), who will be deployed to attack foes.
3. Each <color=#FF423F>Combat Chip</color> has special Additional Effects.

1. When a Phantom Thief deals damage with a skill, gain 1 <color=#FF423F>Attribute Seal</color>.
2. When the party has a total of 7 <color=#FF423F>Attribute Seals</color>, spend all Attribute Seals and activate <color=#FF423F>Starfall</color>: deals Almighty damage to random foes (7 hits). Repeated hits on the same foe deal less damage.

1. At the end of each turn, the Phantom Thieves gain a small amount of <color=#FF423F>Ballista Energy</color>.
2. When an ally deals <color=#FF423F>weakness damage</color>, they gain a large amount of <color=#FF423F>Ballista Energy</color> (activates up to once per turn).
3. When the Phantom Thieves have 100 <color=#FF423F>Ballista Energy</color> at the start of their turn, they automatically spend 100 Ballista Energy to attack with a <color=#FF423F>Ballista Shot</color>.

1. When allies use a Highlight, gain 1 <color=#FF423F>Blazing Starfire</color>.
2. When <color=#FF423F>Blazing Starfire</color> reaches 4 stacks, spend all Blazing Starfire and activate <color=#FF423F>Sparkling Stage</color>. This randomly grants 10 of the following buffs to allies. For each buff, the target ally and effect will be chosen at random: Increase Attack by 15%, increase Defense by 22.5%, increase max HP by 15%, increase damage by 12%, increase ailment accuracy by 18%, increase pierce rate by 6%, increase critical rate by 9%, increase critical damage by 18%, increase resistance pierce rate by 7.5%, or increase weakness damage by 6%.

Gain <color=#FF423F>Spark Powder</color> when certain conditions are met. Once you have gained 1000 Spark Powder, you will automatically spend 1000 Spark Powder to activate <color=#FF423F>Banishing Fireworks</color> and inflict Nian Shou with <color=#FF423F>Terror</color> for 1 turn. When this ailment is active, Nian Shou will be unable to act, and its final damage taken is increased.

1. Barbaric Beast Wheel gains a small amount of Power at the end of each turn.
2. Each time a Phantom Thief deals damage to Barbaric Beast Wheel, it loses a certain amount of Power.
3. At the start of the second phase, Barbaric Beast Wheel's Power gain rate is doubled and it gains Shifting Gears. When Power reaches 80, final damage increases and it gains the Irreversible state, preventing Power from dropping below 80.
4. At the start of the third phase, Barbaric Beast Wheel's final damage greatly increases and it gains Maximum Output, maintaining Power at 100.

Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on difficulty level and current Exploration Level, and also inflict 8 Cracked Pottery stacks.
Cracked Pottery: At the end of each turn, permanently deal a fixed amount of continuous damage based on difficulty level and current Exploration Level. Stacks up to 99 times.
At the end of 1 selected ally's next action, grant them 1 extra action.
Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on difficulty level and current Exploration Level, and fill party's Highlight and Theurgy gauges by 100%.
Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on difficulty level and current Exploration Level.
Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on the total amount healed in this battle. This damage is affected by difficulty level and current Exploration Level.
Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on difficulty level and current Exploration Level (increase by 1% for every 100 points of Wonder's Attack). Also, increase Wonder's Attack by 50%.
Deal a fixed amount of damage to all foes based on total current shield value. This attack is affected by difficulty level and current Exploration Level.
